International Encyclopedia of the Social & Behavioral Sciences
The
International Encyclopedia of the Social & Behavioral Sciences
, originally edited by
Neil J. Smelser
and
Paul B. Baltes
, is a 26-volume work published by
Elsevier
. It has some 4,000 signed articles (commissioned by around 50 subject editors), and includes 150 biographical entries, 122,400 entries, and an extensive hierarchical subject index. It is also available in online editions. Reviewers described the work as "the largest corpus of knowledge about the social and behavioral sciences in existence." and "the atomic bomb of reference works."
